description: This file defines a mock class MockINetworkManager for the INetworkManager interface, used for testing network management functionalities. It includes mocked methods such as GetAvailableInterfaces, SetInterfaceState, GetIPSettings, and more, primarily for use with Google Mock framework.

classes.name: MockINetworkManager
classes.description: A mock implementation of the INetworkManager interface for testing purposes, providing mock methods for network management operations.

methods.name: GetAvailableInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available network interfaces.

methods.name: GetPrimaryInterface
methods.description: Gets the primary network interface name.

methods.name: SetInterfaceState
methods.description: Enables or disables a specified network interface.

methods.name: GetInterfaceState
methods.description: Checks if a specific interface is enabled.

methods.name: GetIPSettings
methods.description: Retrieves IP settings for a given interface.

methods.name: SetIPSettings
methods.description: Sets IP address configuration for an interface.

methods.name: GetStunEndpoint
methods.description: Gets the STUN server endpoint details.

methods.name: GetCaptivePortalURI
methods.description: Gets URI for captive portal detection.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Performs an ICMP ping to a specified endpoint.

methods.name: Trace
methods.description: Performs a traceroute to a specified endpoint.

methods.name: StartWiFiScan
methods.description: Initiates a WiFi scan for available networks.

methods.name: AddToKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Adds an SSID to the known list.

methods.name: RemoveKnownSSID
methods.description: Removes an SSID from the known list.

methods.name: WiFiConnect
methods.description: Connects to a specified WiFi network.

methods.name: WiFiDisconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the current WiFi network.

methods.name: GetConnectedSSID
methods.description: Gets info about the currently connected SSID.

methods.name: GetSupportedSecurityModes
methods.description: Retrieves supported security modes for WiFi.
